Global center line and occultation limits
South-polar azimuthal equidistant projection with Natural Earth 1:50m physical land and no administrative boundaries. Limits use the outer lunar limb on the Earth ellipsoid.
All times are UTC (shown in CST, UTC+08:00). Circular lunar limb.
